source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Once per battle per Incubi Shrine token the unit holds, you may change a single Hit roll or a single Wound roll made for one of this unit's Klaivex or Incubi models so that it counts as an unmodified 6.

wargear.usesPerBattle: one per Incubi Shrine token this unit has

effect.madeFor: a Klaivex or Incubi model in this unit

wargear.designerNote: one token per Incubi Shrine token sits beside the unit and one is removed per use
